title: Copy hygiene: no internal identifiers, no placeholder text, actionable error messages
description: Rendered copy never exposes internal specification identifiers (REQ, US, AC, FBS references), never ships lorem ipsum or placeholder strings in any reachable state, and phrases error messages around what the user can do next rather than what the user did wrong.
rationale: Internal ids and placeholder text in rendered copy are the leak-shaped defects that erode user trust instantly and are trivially checkable.
